text:
deploy-bot: Preflight check for rollout embed-service v2.14.0 -> v2.15.0 completed. Observability snapshot shows p95 eu-west embed-route ~760ms (SLO=350ms), error_rate=0.9% (SLO=0.5%). Heatmap jitter across trace buckets increased. Suggest: PAUSE at 30% and run quick smoke/kvcache crosscheck. :warning:

maria.k: Confirming — dashboard p95 spike lines up with kvcache miss rate spike and increased backend latencies. Not seeing corresponding CPU/GPU pressure.

sam.g: Can we get the exact probe frames? grabbing logs now.

sam.g: ```
[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] embed-route request failed fast: KVCacheLookupMiss
[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] redis: connection_retries=2, err=ETIMEDOUT
[2026-03-22T18:12:04Z] backend-embed p95=340ms -> 480ms
```

leo.ops: Looks like transient network to redis cluster eu-west-2a. kvcache misses will amplify p95 at the edge. Agreed we should hold traffic and pin to previous revision while infra investigates.

priya: I'm pausing traffic to v2.15.0 now. Command: `/deploy pause --service=embed-service --version=v2.15.0 --percent=30`

maria.k: I also bumped canary sampling retention to 10m to collect more traces: `opsctl observability update-sampling --service=embed-route --duration=10m`.

leo.ops: Pinning routing back to stable: `deployctl routing set-weight embed-service v2.14.0=100 v2.15.0=0` — running now.

deploy-bot: Action taken: rollout paused at 30%. Routing change applied to pin to v2.14.0. Canary traces stored for 10m. Created issue RB-1234 to track infra investigation.

sam.g: Opening quick infra ticket to network team and attaching trace examples. Noting redis timeout spikes from 18:11:50 to 18:13:20 UTC.

priya: Ops checklist: 1) hold traffic, 2) increase traces, 3) pin version, 4) escalate to infra, 5) wait 15m and reevaluate.

maria.k: Agreed. If p95 and error_rate don't improve in 15m, we'll revert the change permanently or roll back the entire deploy. For now we keep hold and monitor dashboards.

leo.ops: FYI linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-eviction and the release notes for this rollout: https://redwood.internal/releases/embed/v2.15.0/notes

sam.g: Infra acknowledged, will check redis cluster connectivity and client timeouts. ETA 10m.

maria.k: Thanks. I'll keep watch on SLO dashboard and post updates. :eyes:
